text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A government bill on defence and security policy passed its second reading in parliament on Tuesday. The bill states that none of the defence and security forces are party political in nature and owe loyalty exclusively to the constitution, the law and the nation.

- The General Inspectorate of Finance has accused parliament of serious abuse of state funds. The inspectorate, which is a specialised agency of the Planning and Finance Ministry, carried out a three-month investigation into the assembly's finances from late October to late January.
